title: Abu Dhabi health department signs 22 US agreements to expand genomics and AI research
description: Abu Dhabi's Department of Health signed 22 partnerships during a US mission. The agreements span AI, genomics, biomanufacturing, and the region's first eye bank.

title: Can digital twins help athletes win? How AI is changing sport
description: From analysing a sprinter’s stride to identifying a footballer’s potential, AI has joined the coaching staff to help build the next gen of athletes

title: Goldman Says AI Bubble Fears Overblown, Names 3 Themes to Watch
description: Goldman Sachs strategist Ben Snider calls AI bubble fears overblown, citing solid fundamentals and rising earnings, and names AI infrastructure, power and hyperscalers as themes to watch.

title: India weighs new AI law amid evolving cyber threats and deepfakes
description: India is weighing a dedicated AI law, an IT official said, amid rising cyber threats. Simultaneous enforcement hit VPNs, Chinese apps, and Meta over child abuse content.
